text:
Jamie L: Quick heads-up — PR #482 updates the Aurora-Lite-3B model card (limits + quant notes). Need eyes on SDK snippets and the runtime compatibility links. cc @Sana
Sana R: On it. I will verify python/js snippets and the runtime-compat matrix anchors. Any benchmark numbers to include?
Jamie L: Yes — small perf summary from the bench: 512-seq throughput ~220 tok/s on r5a.large-ish instance family, p95 ~95ms, p99 ~120ms. Also note: KV-cache currently disabled for INT8 quant build. Gist with logs in the PR.
Max G: I can take SDK examples. Will change the sample to show both the standard and quantized model ids and add a caveat about streaming fallback.
Max G: snippet I'm planning:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# recommended: pin version for Dedicated customers
resp = client.generate(model='aurora-lite-3b@v1.2.0', input='Summarize...')
```
Eli P: Heads-up — the limits table in the card still lists 2k seq. We should update to 4k sequence ceiling and add a "recommended batch size" (8 for low-latency, 32 for throughput). I'll push a tiny markdown patch.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #482: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood-inference.io/482 — staging build passed, but anchor tests failed (see logs).
Sana R: The runtime-compatibility doc moved the Aurora anchors after the restructure; the anchor in the card points to `#aurora-family` but the page uses `#aurora-lite`. I'll fix the anchor and add a redirect link.
Jamie L: Also please add a short migration note for Dedicated: pin model version to `@v1.2.0` while we stabilize quant variants. Max — can you include the pinning snippet in both python and node?
Max G: Yep. I'll add a Node example and a one-liner showing `model='aurora-lite-3b@v1.2.0'`. Pushed to branch `aurora-card-snippets`.
Eli P: Quick wording nit: change "quantization may reduce accuracy" to "quantization may introduce a small delta in generation quality; validate against your eval set." Small but clearer.
Sana R: Agreed. After I fix anchors and update snippets, I'll re-run the deploy preview tests. ETA ~45m.
Jamie L: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Merge after CI green. If anything blocks, drop a note here and we'll triage.
Max G: FYI I added a one-paragraph migration checklist for customers who use Dedicated (pin version, test eval prompts, prefer batch size 8 for latency).
Eli P: Merged the limits table fix. No docs build errors on my branch.
Sana R: Deploy preview now shows correct anchors and updated snippets. All green.
Jamie L: Great — merging PR #482. Thanks team! :rocket:
